def reference(x, y):
    """Obviously correct model: biggest even integer k with x <= k <= y, else -1."""

        return -1
    hi = math.floor(y)
    if hi % 2 != 0:
        hi -= 1
    if hi < x:
        return -1
    return hi

    # test both orderings: ordered and swapped
    assert choose_num(lo, hi) == reference(lo, hi)
    assert choose_num(hi, lo) == reference(hi, lo)
